correctness.rationale: The ambient domain has exactly 90 codewords and is exhaustively regenerated. For every ambient pair, the defining minimum over 8-by-8 representative permutations is computed with both LCS dynamic programming and an independent relative-permutation LIS implementation; the full distance matrices agree. Exact Bron--Kerbosch search gives maximum size five and 72 maxima, a separate fixed-size search proves existence of a five-clique and nonexistence of a six-clique, and a nested census independently reproduces all 72 maxima. Every structural and orbit assertion is then checked against that complete census.

value.rationale: The target is the smallest natural three-rank regular multipermutation cell with two cells per rank at the single-translocation-correction distance threshold. The result closes both the exact cardinality and the full equality layer. The one-factorization structure connects every optimum to a canonical design on six labeled cells, and the single S6 orbit gives a reusable symmetry benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
